title: E-FRC-0114: a pair rule that keeps a color triality as a glide in time, sigma $U_t = U_{t+2}$ sigma, with no...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0114 in the gauge arena: a pair rule that keeps a color triality as a glide in time, sigma $U_t = U_{t+2}$ sigma, with no four-line vertex: it reverses exactly, conserves charge, moves a single tone from a color line onto one orbit line, which no rule symmetric beat by beat can do, and connects all twelve lines.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
